title: A website's footer credit is the owner's choice: badge, text line, or none when paid for (LIVE-1117)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 ("Network can resell"): PR 1 of the Network website reseller program, ADR-1816.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. Every footer drew the Frequency Partner badge with no setting. preferences.siteBadge now holds badge (default), line or none (lib/sites/site-badge.ts). None only takes effect for a Space on Independent or holding the badge_removal entitlement; a saved none without it reads as the badge, so a lapse restores the badge with no cleanup. The setSiteBadge action refuses none without the right, and the Website card on Profile & Settings carries the choice. Nothing grants badge_removal yet: per-site Network billing (the next PR of the program) sets it.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/site-chrome.tsx','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/site-page.tsx','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('lib/sites/site-badge.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/credit === 'badge' &&/.test(c))bad.push('badge is not conditional');if(!p.includes('effectiveFooterBadge'))bad.push('page does not gate the credit');if(!b.includes('badgeRemovalHeld'))bad.push('no removal gate');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1117: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the footer badge stops being conditional or its removal stops being gated.
